Pizza Style Pasta
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 25, 2009 - 12:15am

Ingredients




3 cups cooked Primo Rotini Pasta, drained
2 cups pizza sauce
1 cup each sliced pepperoni and red pepper strips
2 cups grated Kraft Mozzarella Cheese, divided

Preparation

1 MIX all ingredients, except 1/2 cup cheese. 2 PLACE in a lightly greased 10 inch round shallow casserole. Top with reserved cheese. 3 BAKE at 350 F for 20 minutes or until hot. 4 Makes 8 servings
